name: Abigail
bio: Abigail lives at Pierre's General Store with her parents. She has a dark, adventurous spirit and loves the occult.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Pierre's General Store while Abigail is there
heartEvents.title: A Game Night
heartEvents.description: Abigail asks you to play a game of Praetorian Edition. She's competitive and very spirited.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Mountain Lake area on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Flute Practice
heartEvents.description: Abigail is playing her flute by the mountain lake. She shares her love for music.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Town on a rainy day
heartEvents.title: Ouija Board
heartEvents.description: Abigail asks if you believe in ghosts. She reveals she has an Ouija board and wants to contact the spirits.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Graveyard at night
heartEvents.title: Grave Investigation
heartEvents.description: Abigail wants to explore the graveyard at night looking for paranormal activity.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Abigail shares her feelings about her place in the world and her relationship with you.

romance.roomChanges: Abigail's room has purple walls, a computer, and alt-girl vibes.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Helps on the farm, visits town occasionally.

name: Alex
bio: Alex lives with his grandparents Evelyn and George. He is athletic, cocky, and dreams of becoming a professional gridball player.

heartEvents.trigger: Visit Alex's house when he is home
heartEvents.title: Gridball Practice
heartEvents.description: Alex talks about his gridball practice and shows off his athletic skills.

heartEvents.trigger: Visit the Beach on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Beach Day
heartEvents.description: Alex is at the beach working out. He opens up about his parents.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town on a sunny morning
heartEvents.title: Breakfast with George
heartEvents.description: Alex shows a softer side as he cares for his grandfather George.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town in the afternoon
heartEvents.title: Dirty Talk
heartEvents.description: Alex reveals his vulnerability and questions his future in sports.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Alex confesses his love and talks about building a future together.

romance.roomChanges: Alex brings gridball decor and sports equipment to the farmhouse.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Helps on the farm, visits his grandparents on Sundays.

name: Elliott
bio: Elliott is a writer who lives alone in a cabin on the beach. He is romantic, eloquent, and searching for inspiration for his novel.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Elliott's Cabin when he is home
heartEvents.title: Writer's Block
heartEvents.description: Elliott struggles with writer's block and discusses his novel.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Beach on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: The Piano
heartEvents.description: Elliott plays a piece on the piano and shares his love of music.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Beach in the evening
heartEvents.title: A Night at the Beach
heartEvents.description: Elliott reads poetry to you by the sea.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Elliott's Cabin after receiving his letter
heartEvents.title: The Novel
heartEvents.description: Elliott reveals he's finished his novel and dedicates it to you.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Elliott expresses his deep feelings and asks you to be with him forever.

romance.roomChanges: Elliott brings a bookshelf and writing desk to the farmhouse.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Writes at home, visits the beach for inspiration.

name: Emily
bio: Emily lives with her sister Haley. She works at the Stardrop Saloon and is deeply spiritual, passionate about gemstones, and loves making her own clothes.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Emily's house when she is home
heartEvents.title: Gemstones
heartEvents.description: Emily shows you her gemstone collection and explains their spiritual meanings.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Clothing Therapy
heartEvents.description: Emily talks about her passion for making clothes and expressing yourself through fashion.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Stardrop Saloon at night
heartEvents.title: Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
heartEvents.description: Emily invites you to watch the Moonlight Jellies with her.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Emily's house after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Crystal Healing
heartEvents.description: Emily reveals her deep spiritual connection to nature and crystals.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Emily shares her vision of a beautiful future together.

romance.roomChanges: Emily's room has a crystal garden, gemstone display, and a sewing machine.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Works at the Saloon on busy days, does yoga at home.

name: Haley
bio: Haley lives with her older sister Emily. She is initially shallow and obsessed with fashion and photography, but grows kinder over time.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Haley's house when she is home
heartEvents.title: Photography
heartEvents.description: Haley shows you her photography collection. She's passionate about capturing moments.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Lost Bracelet
heartEvents.description: Haley loses her bracelet and asks for your help finding it.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Beach on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Beach Photos
heartEvents.description: Haley is taking photos at the beach and asks for your opinion.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Haley's house after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Pie Baking
heartEvents.description: Haley attempts to bake a pie and shows her vulnerable, growing side.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Haley confesses how much you've changed her for the better.

romance.roomChanges: Haley brings a photo studio setup and fashion items to the farmhouse.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Takes photos around the farm, helps with chores.

name: Harvey
bio: Harvey is the town doctor. He is a bit timid and anxious but deeply caring. He lives alone in a small apartment above his clinic.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Harvey's Clinic
heartEvents.title: Check-Up
heartEvents.description: Harvey gives you a free check-up and talks about his passion for medicine.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Stardrop Saloon on a rainy day
heartEvents.title: Model Planes
heartEvents.description: Harvey reveals his hobby of building model planes.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Hot Air Balloon
heartEvents.description: Harvey talks about his dream of riding in a hot air balloon.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Harvey's Clinic after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Medical Skills
heartEvents.description: Harvey shows you his medical equipment and shares his insecurities.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Harvey nervously confesses his love and asks to be together.

romance.roomChanges: Harvey brings medical textbooks and a model plane collection to the farmhouse.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Works at the clinic, helps on the farm in the evenings.

name: Leah
bio: Leah is an artist who lives alone in a cottage outside of town. She loves nature, foraging, and creating sculptures from driftwood.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Leah's Cottage when she is home
heartEvents.title: Wood Sculpture
heartEvents.description: Leah shows you her latest driftwood sculpture and talks about her art.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Forest on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Nature Walk
heartEvents.description: Leah invites you for a walk in the forest to forage and gather inspiration.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Leah's Cottage in the evening
heartEvents.title: Ex-Boyfriend
heartEvents.description: Leah's ex-boyfriend Kel visits and causes tension. She stands up for herself.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Forest after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Art Show
heartEvents.description: Leah prepares for an art show and asks for your support.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Leah expresses her love in a romantic forest setting.

romance.roomChanges: Leah turns a corner of the farmhouse into an art studio.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Continues sculpting at home, forages in the forest.

name: Maru
bio: Maru lives in the mountains with her parents Robin and Demetrius, and her half-brother Sebastian. She is a brilliant inventor and works at Harvey's Clinic.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Mountain Road area
heartEvents.title: The Telescope
heartEvents.description: Maru shows you her telescope and talks about astronomy.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Gadget Demo
heartEvents.description: Maru demonstrates her latest invention.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Mountain Lake at night
heartEvents.title: Stargazing
heartEvents.description: Maru invites you to stargaze at the mountain lake.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Maru's room after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Robot Project
heartEvents.description: Maru reveals her secret robot project and asks for your opinion.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Maru shares her dreams for the future and confesses her love.

romance.roomChanges: Maru sets up a workshop with gadgets and science equipment.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Works on inventions at home, visits the clinic periodically.

name: Penny
bio: Penny lives in a small trailer with her alcoholic mother Pam. She is shy, kind, and teaches the town's children Jas and Vincent.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Trailer when Penny is home
heartEvents.title: Cleaning Up
heartEvents.description: Penny cleans up the messy trailer and shares her frustrations about her home life.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Helping Others
heartEvents.description: Penny talks about teaching Jas and Vincent and her love for education.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Museum after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Library Visit
heartEvents.description: Penny asks you to meet her at the museum. She shares her favorite books.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Spa in the afternoon
heartEvents.title: Pool Day
heartEvents.description: Penny opens up about her mother's drinking and her dreams of a better life.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Penny confesses her love and hopes for a future away from the trailer.

romance.roomChanges: Penny adds bookshelves, plants, and cozy decor to the farmhouse.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Continues teaching children, keeps the farmhouse cozy.

name: Sam
bio: Sam lives with his mother Jodi, father Kent, and little brother Vincent. He is energetic, loves music, skateboarding, and dreams of being a musician.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Sam's house when he is home
heartEvents.title: Band Practice
heartEvents.description: Sam is practicing guitar in his room. He talks about his band.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Skateboarding
heartEvents.description: Sam shows off his skateboarding tricks and talks about his dreams.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Beach in the afternoon
heartEvents.title: Band Practice
heartEvents.description: Sam's band plays at the beach. He invites you to listen.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Sam's house after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Dad's Return
heartEvents.description: Sam opens up about his father Kent returning from war and his anxieties.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Sam expresses his love and promises to always be there for you.

romance.roomChanges: Sam sets up a music corner with his guitar and band memorabilia.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Continues playing music, helps on the farm.

name: Sebastian
bio: Sebastian lives in the basement of his mother Robin's house. He is introverted, moody, enjoys programming, tabletop RPGs, and motorcycles.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Sebastian's basement room
heartEvents.title: Tabletop RPGs
heartEvents.description: Sebastian is playing Solitaire Chronicles and invites you to join.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Mountain Lake on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Cigarette Break
heartEvents.description: Sebastian is by the lake and opens up about his life.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town on a rainy day
heartEvents.title: Motorcycle
heartEvents.description: Sebastian shows you his motorcycle and talks about his desire to travel.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Sebastian's room after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Programming
heartEvents.description: Sebastian shows you his programming project and shares his ambitions.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Sebastian confesses his love and decides to stay in the valley.

romance.roomChanges: Sebastian brings a computer setup and frog terrarium to the farmhouse.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Works on programming, helps on the farm, visits his mother.

name: Shane
bio: Shane lives with his aunt Marnie and god-daughter Jas. He struggles with depression and alcoholism but is passionate about chickens and hot peppers.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Marnie's Ranch when Shane is home
heartEvents.title: Chicken Talk
heartEvents.description: Shane shows you his chickens, especially his favorite blue chicken Charlie.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Stardrop Saloon on a rainy day
heartEvents.title: Hitting Rock Bottom
heartEvents.description: Shane is drunk at the saloon and opens up about his struggles.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Microwave Dinner
heartEvents.description: Shane invites you over for a microwaved dinner and reveals more about his past.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Marnie's Ranch after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Recovery
heartEvents.description: Shane shows you his progress in getting better and thanks you for your support.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Bus Stop after receiving letter
heartEvents.title: Ten Heart Event
heartEvents.description: Shane confesses his love and shows you his blue chicken.

romance.roomChanges: Shane brings chicken memorabilia and a messy corner to the farmhouse.
romance.scheduleAfterMarriage: Helps with farm animals, visits Marnie's Ranch.

name: Caroline
bio: Caroline is Pierre's wife and Abigail's mother. She runs a community garden project and enjoys tea ceremonies in her sunroom.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Caroline's sunroom
heartEvents.title: Tea Ceremony
heartEvents.description: Caroline invites you to a tea ceremony in her sunroom and shares her knowledge of herbs.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Pierre's General Store
heartEvents.title: Community Garden
heartEvents.description: Caroline talks about her community garden project and asks for your help.

name: Clint
bio: Clint is the town blacksmith. He is shy, socially awkward, and has a secret crush on Emily. He spends most of his time at the forge.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Clint's Blacksmith
heartEvents.title: Geode Processing
heartEvents.description: Clint shows you how he processes geodes and talks about his craft.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Stardrop Saloon on a Friday
heartEvents.title: Advice on Emily
heartEvents.description: Clint asks for your advice on how to talk to Emily.

name: Demetrius
bio: Demetrius is a biologist and researcher living in the mountains. He is married to Robin and is the father of Maru and step-father of Sebastian.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Demetrius's laboratory
heartEvents.title: Research
heartEvents.description: Demetrius shows you his latest biological research and experiments.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Mountain area
heartEvents.title: Tomato Debate
heartEvents.description: Demetrius and Robin argue about whether tomatoes are fruits. He asks for your opinion.

name: Evelyn
bio: Evelyn is the kindly grandmother of the valley. She lives with her husband George and grandson Alex. She loves baking and gardening.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Evelyn's house
heartEvents.title: Baking Cookies
heartEvents.description: Evelyn teaches you her secret cookie recipe and shares stories of the old days.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town Garden
heartEvents.title: Gardening Tips
heartEvents.description: Evelyn shares her gardening wisdom and gives you a rare seed.

name: George
bio: George is Evelyn's husband and Alex's grandfather. He uses a wheelchair and can be grumpy, but has a warm heart underneath.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter George's house
heartEvents.title: Grumpy Old Man
heartEvents.description: George complains about modern times but eventually shares stories of his youth.

name: Gus
bio: Gus runs the Stardrop Saloon. He is a friendly, generous man who loves cooking and always serves the best food in town.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Stardrop Saloon
heartEvents.title: Cooking Lesson
heartEvents.description: Gus shows you how to make one of his signature dishes.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Stardrop Saloon at night
heartEvents.title: Community Support
heartEvents.description: Gus talks about how the saloon brings the community together.

name: Jas
bio: Jas is a young girl who lives with her aunt Marnie and godfather Shane. She is shy but playful, loves dolls, and attends Penny's lessons.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Marnie's Ranch
heartEvents.title: Doll Collection
heartEvents.description: Jas shows you her doll collection and talks about her friends.

name: Jodi
bio: Jodi is a caring mother of two boys, Sam and Vincent. She manages the household while her husband Kent is away serving in the military.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Jodi's house
heartEvents.title: Family Duties
heartEvents.description: Jodi talks about the challenges of raising two boys while her husband is away.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Kitchen at Jodi's house
heartEvents.title: Cooking Help
heartEvents.description: Jodi asks for help with dinner and shares her favorite recipes.

name: Kent
bio: Kent is Jodi's husband and father to Sam and Vincent. He recently returned from military service and struggles with PTSD.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Kent's house
heartEvents.title: War Stories
heartEvents.description: Kent shares some of his experiences from the war. He seems troubled.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Town on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Popcorn Popping
heartEvents.description: Kent is startled by the sound of popcorn popping, showing his PTSD.

name: Lewis
bio: Lewis is the mayor of Stardew Valley. He has served for over 20 years and takes pride in the community, though he has a secret relationship with Marnie.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Mayor's Manor
heartEvents.title: Town Projects
heartEvents.description: Lewis discusses upcoming town projects and asks for your input.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Marnie's Ranch
heartEvents.title: Secret Affair
heartEvents.description: You catch Lewis sneaking out of Marnie's ranch. He asks you to keep it secret.

name: Linus
bio: Linus lives in a tent north of town. He chooses a simple life close to nature and is kind-hearted despite being misunderstood by the townsfolk.

heartEvents.trigger: Visit Linus's tent
heartEvents.title: Wilderness Living
heartEvents.description: Linus explains his philosophy of living in harmony with nature.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Mountain area at night
heartEvents.title: Bait and Switch
heartEvents.description: Someone sets a prank on Linus. He handles it with grace and dignity.

name: Marnie
bio: Marnie runs a ranch outside of town where she raises animals. She is kind and nurturing, and has a secret romance with Mayor Lewis.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Marnie's Ranch
heartEvents.title: Animal Care
heartEvents.description: Marnie shows you how she cares for her animals and gives you a petting guide.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Marnie's Ranch in the evening
heartEvents.title: Secret Romance
heartEvents.description: Marnie hints at her secret relationship and asks if you can keep a secret.

name: Pam
bio: Pam lives in a trailer with her daughter Penny. She drives the bus to the desert and struggles with alcoholism, but cares deeply for her daughter.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Trailer
heartEvents.title: TV Time
heartEvents.description: Pam invites you to watch TV with her and shares stories about her younger days.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Stardrop Saloon at night
heartEvents.title: Motherly Concerns
heartEvents.description: Pam expresses her worries about Penny and hopes for a better life for her.

name: Pierre
bio: Pierre runs the local general store. He is a proud businessman who competes with JojaMart and can sometimes be possessive of his family.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Pierre's General Store
heartEvents.title: Business Rivalry
heartEvents.description: Pierre complains about JojaMart and his struggle to keep the local store afloat.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Pierre's store on a Wednesday
heartEvents.title: Family Drama
heartEvents.description: Pierre expresses frustration about his family not appreciating his hard work.

name: Robin
bio: Robin is the town carpenter and runs her own shop. She is married to Demetrius and mother to Maru and Sebastian. She loves woodworking.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Robin's Carpentry Shop
heartEvents.title: Woodworking
heartEvents.description: Robin shows you her latest woodworking project and talks about her craft.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Robin's house in the evening
heartEvents.title: Family Dinner
heartEvents.description: Robin invites you to a family dinner and shares stories about her kids.

name: Sandy
bio: Sandy runs the Oasis shop in the Calico Desert. She is cheerful and bright, always happy to see visitors from the valley.

heartEvents.trigger: Visit Sandy's Oasis
heartEvents.title: Desert Life
heartEvents.description: Sandy talks about living in the desert and how much she misses the valley.

name: Vincent
bio: Vincent is a young boy who lives with his parents Jodi and Kent, and his older brother Sam. He is playful, curious, and loves bugs and frogs.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Vincent's house
heartEvents.title: Bug Collection
heartEvents.description: Vincent shows you his bug collection and tells you fun facts about each one.

name: Willy
bio: Willy is the town fisherman. He lives alone in his fish shop on the beach and spends his days fishing and repairing boats. He has a mysterious past.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter Willy's Fish Shop
heartEvents.title: Fishing Tales
heartEvents.description: Willy shares stories of the legendary fish he has caught in his lifetime.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Beach on a sunny day
heartEvents.title: Boat Repair
heartEvents.description: Willy shows you his old boat and talks about his dream of sailing the seas.

name: Wizard
bio: The Wizard, also known as M. Rasmodius, lives in a mysterious tower in the forest. He studies the arcane and has knowledge of the valley's ancient magic.

heartEvents.trigger: Enter the Wizard's Tower
heartEvents.title: Arcane Studies
heartEvents.description: The Wizard reveals secrets about the valley's magical history and asks for your help.

name: Krobus
bio: Krobus is a friendly shadow monster who lives in the sewers. He sells rare items and loves cooking. He can become a roommate instead of a spouse.

heartEvents.trigger: Visit Krobus in the Sewers
heartEvents.title: Shadow Friend
heartEvents.description: Krobus shares his story about being a shadow person and living in the sewers.

heartEvents.trigger: Visit Krobus on a rainy day
heartEvents.title: Cooking Together
heartEvents.description: Krobus asks you to try his special sewer truffle recipe.

name: Dwarf
bio: The Dwarf lives in the mines and sells rare minerals and bombs. He speaks in an ancient language and has a deep love for gems and artifacts.

heartEvents.trigger: Visit the Dwarf in the Mines
heartEvents.title: Language Barrier
heartEvents.description: The Dwarf tries to communicate with you. He teaches you some of his ancient language.

name: Leo
bio: Leo is a young boy who grew up on Ginger Island raised by parrots. He is shy around people but deeply connected to nature and the jungle.

heartEvents.trigger: Visit Leo on Ginger Island
heartEvents.title: Parrot Friend
heartEvents.description: Leo introduces you to his parrot family and shows you around the island.

heartEvents.trigger: Visit Leo's Treehouse
heartEvents.title: Leaving the Island
heartEvents.description: Leo talks about his feelings about possibly moving to the mainland.
